text_simplified: Among the qualities of the servants of the Most Merciful is supplicating for their spouses and offspring to be a comfort to their eyes through obedience to Allah and following the Sunnah of His Prophet ﷺ. Parents must fear Allah and beware of praying against their children in moments of anger and intense emotion, lest it coincide with an hour of acceptance and leave them with regret and sorrow; Qatadah and Abd al-Rahman al-Sa'di (may Allah have mercy on them both) explained that praying against one's child for evil in anger stems from human haste and ignorance.
